summary: Frontend-only testing of the AI-generator for App-Test tasks on /admin/tasks. All 5 required scenarios PASS: (1) AI panel appears only when 'App Test' category is selected; (2) AI generates title/Einleitung/Schritt1-3 with German text in ~7s and shows success toast; (3) Task is created and appears under the 'App Tests' tab with the App Test badge; (4) Duplicate generation returns HTTP 409 and the UI shows a German error toast ('Für die App "..." existiert bereits eine Aufgabe.') without overwriting form fields; (5) AI panel is NOT rendered when 'BD' category is selected. Created task and leftover 'TestApp QA Zeta 2026' task were cleaned up via API.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminTasks.jsx generateWithAI flow correctly handles 200 (fills form + success toast) and 409 (error toast, no overwrite). Verified end-to-end.
AI panel conditional rendering (formData.category==='app') works correctly - hidden on BD.
Note: Prior testing runs left an orphan task 'QA-Check: ... TestApp QA Zeta 2026'; recommend adding a cleanup step in test docs or a backend maintenance endpoint. Cleaned during this run.
seed_data_creation: Created task with unique app_name 'UniqueQA-1786285920' and deleted it via DELETE /api/admin/tasks/{id}. Also deleted leftover 'TestApp QA Zeta 2026' task from prior runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI generation via Gemini takes ~5-15s. Duplicate detection is case-insensitive (backend lowercases ai_app_name). Login route is /admin/login. Admin login sets both localStorage 'admin_token' and 'login_time'. To avoid 409 on retest, always use a fresh unique app name (e.g. include timestamp).
